questions.q: Step 1: "Why this matters and who needs it: scan the local market and name one real user or customer." Which kind of work is this? (DO = practise, SHARE = learn with others, STUDY = read and learn.)
Step 2: "Kick-off circle: each learner states a goal; mentor sets the evidence you will produce." Which kind of work is this? (DO = practise, SHARE = learn with others, STUDY = read and learn.)
Step 3: "Start the practice task: Understand the science, regulation and ethics at overview level." Which kind of work is this? (DO = practise, SHARE = learn with others, STUDY = read and learn.)
Step 5: "Continue and log every step, cost and problem in your record." Which kind of work is this? (DO = practise, SHARE = learn with others, STUDY = read and learn.)
Step 7: "Finish the task, measure the result against your goal, write three lessons learned." Which kind of work is this? (DO = practise, SHARE = learn with others, STUDY = read and learn.)
Step 8: "Present your evidence to a review room; give two peers written feedback." Which kind of work is this? (DO = practise, SHARE = learn with others, STUDY = read and learn.)
